acceptance_scope: Figure protocol and visual inspection only; scientific gates are reported separately.
inspection_method: Every preview inspected on contact sheets, with full-size review of complex layouts and newly repaired summary figures. Titles, dates, axes, legends, dense data, source colors, empty regions, and clipping checked. Regional middle-50% envelope revision: every affected preview reinspected in full-resolution four-up sheets and representative full-size figures, including sparse sites, missing days, absent one-site bands, statistics strips, legends, and extreme smoke AOD. Isolated-day interval repair: all changed figures individually reinspected at original resolution; unaffected panels retain prior inspection. Independent daily revision: every changed regional preview inspected at original resolution, checking compact titles, map insets underneath curves, paired-site middle-50% spread, isolated intervals, missing days and daily statistics. inspection_conventions: Scatter compares satellite and AERONET: quantity-only AOD title and source names on axes follow DAVINCI CLAUDE.md lines 813-823.
Southern Ocean is the region south of 40 degrees S, including land and islands; it is not an ocean-only surface mask.

regional_envelope_revision.sampling: Each source independently averages its UTC-day samples; only site-days with both daily means enter the comparison.
regional_envelope_revision.band: 25th–75th percentiles across the same active sites, separately for each source’s independently sampled daily means.
regional_envelope_revision.statistics: Paired displayed daily regional averages: matched days, bias, RMSE, correlation and mean absolute difference / mean AERONET × 100.
regional_envelope_revision.isolated_interval_display: Middle-50% bands extend six hours either side of isolated multi-site days; missing and single-site spread gaps remain open.
regional_envelope_revision.layout: AOD 550 nm title left and geographic ranges before dates in the same right-aligned subtitle, Time inside axes, two left-aligned footer lines; geographic inset chooses the clearest position fully inside axes, underneath curves and translucent spread bands, with coastlines clipped to the exact region extent.
